Hi Laura —

Thanks for choosing Redwood. To finish vendor onboarding on our side we need two items so Finance can map inbound POs to your remittance: 

1) A bank-letter or ACH enrollment document from your bank confirming account name, routing number, and account number (scanned PDF).
2) A short CSV mapping showing how your invoice fields should map to our PO numbers / remit reference (we attached a sample template below).

Could you send the bank letter and the completed PO-mapping-template.csv? If you prefer we can accept a signed letter on bank stationery instead of the bank PDF.

Also: please confirm whether your remittance advice requires an invoice number only, or invoice + invoice line detail. That helps our AP to route payments correctly.

Attaching: PO-mapping-template.csv (sample).

Thanks —
